description: This header file defines structures, constants, and function prototypes related to firmware image headers, checksum calculations, and command line options for a firmware utility project.

methods.name: cs_is_tagged
methods.description: Checks if the file is tagged with a specific checksum or marker.

methods.name: cs_read_sum
methods.description: Reads the checksum value from a file.

methods.name: cs_calc_sum
methods.description: Calculates the checksum of a file.

methods.name: cs_set_sum
methods.description: Sets the checksum value in a file.

methods.name: cs_get_sum
methods.description: Retrieves the checksum value from a file.

methods.name: cs_validate_file
methods.description: Validates the integrity of a file based on checksum.

methods.name: cmdline_print
methods.description: Prints command line usage or options.

methods.name: cmdline_getarg_list
methods.description: Retrieves argument list for a specific option.

methods.name: cmdline_getarg_count
methods.description: Returns the number of arguments for a list.

methods.name: cmdline_getopt_count
methods.description: Returns the number of arguments for a specific option.

methods.name: cmdline_getarg
methods.description: Retrieves a specific argument from a list.

methods.name: cmdline_error
methods.description: Returns error message string for a given error code.

methods.name: nsp_img_hdr_get_section_ptr_by_name
methods.description: Gets pointer to section header by name.

methods.name: nsp_img_hdr_get_section_offset_by_name
methods.description: Gets offset of section by name.

methods.name: nsp_img_hdr_get_section_size_by_name
methods.description: Gets size of section by name.
